header: Date calculations for the search bar, with Luxon only (my rule for dates in this project). Pure: `now` is a parameter so the tests fix it; nothing is stored or sent. What I understand, in plain words: days between 1 jan 2026 and 15 mar 2026 15/03/2026 - 01/01/2026 is NOT read as a date calculation (it is arithmetic), but "days from X to Y" is 90 days from today · 30 days after 5 march 2026 · 2 weeks before 1 dec 2026 · 45 days ago · 5 jan 2026 + 3 months age 15/08/1985 · age born 15 aug 1985 retirement date born 15/08/1975 what day is 26 jan 2027 · week number of 3 march 2026 days until 25 dec 2026 · days since 1 jan 2026 · days left in 2026 working days between 1 jan 2026 and 31 jan 2026 (Monday to Friday; holidays are NOT taken out, and the answer says so) today's date I write dates the Indian way: day first (15/08/1985 is 15 August). I accept a date without a year only in "days until 25 dec" (the next one).

symbols.name: parseDate
symbols.sig: export function parseDate(text: string, now?: DateTime, nextYear = false): DateTime | null
doc: Returns one date, or null. `now` fixes "today". I give a date with no year the NEXT such day when `nextYear` is set.

symbols.name: retirementDate
symbols.sig: export function retirementDate(dob: DateTime, age = 60): { birthday: DateTime; retires: DateTime }
doc: Superannuation: I take it on attaining `age` (60), at the end of that month, or of the month before when the birthday is the 1st (the usual public-sector rule: confirm with HR).

symbols.name: answerDateQuestion
symbols.sig: export function answerDateQuestion(raw: string, now?: DateTime): DateAnswer | null
doc: Answers a date calculation question; I return null when the text is not one. `now` fixes today.

behaviours: dates are read the Indian way, in many spellings
today, tomorrow, yesterday
an impossible date is not a date
a date without a year is the next one, only when asked
days between two dates
the order of the two dates does not matter
between: years, months, days, weeks, working days
the difference between
a date plus days, weeks, months, years
before and ago
a date of birth in the future is not an age
retirement: end of the month of the 60th birthday; the 1st means the month before
retirement says its rule and the time left
retirementDate directly, with another age
what day is a date
days until, days since, days left in the year
days until a date with no year is the next one
days until a past date, or days since a future date, is nothing
working days, both ends included, holidays not taken out
'what is' and a trailing ? are ignored
not a date question: arithmetic dates, sentences, years, circular titles
a very long text is refused
the module uses Luxon and never the Date object
